payload.prompt: Realize o encerramento anual simplificado de 2025: 1) Calcule e registe a depreciação anual de três ativos: IT-utstyr (65350 NOK, 5 anos lineares, conta 1210), Kjøretøy (201500 NOK, 7 anos, conta 1230), Programvare (212350 NOK, 3 anos, conta 1250). Use conta 6010 para despesa de depreciação e 1209 para depreciação acumulada. 2) Reverta despesas antecipadas (total 60550 NOK na conta 1700). 3) Calcule e registe a provisão fiscal (22 % do resultado tributável) na conta 8700/2920. Registe cada depreciação como um lançamento separado.

payload.goal: Execute simplified 2025 year-end closing: post three separate annual depreciation vouchers, reverse prepaid expenses on account 1700, and post tax provision at 22% of taxable income using 8700/2920.
likely_resources: trial balance / taxable income report for 2025
success_checks: Three separate depreciation vouchers are created for 2025 with correct amounts and account mappings
Annual depreciation amounts match straight-line calculations: 13070 NOK, 28785.71 NOK, 70783.33 NOK
Prepaid expenses reversal of 60550 NOK is posted against account 1700 in 2025
Tax provision voucher uses 22% of taxable income and posts between 8700 and 2920
All vouchers are dated within fiscal year 2025 and balanced
risk_notes: Taxable income amount is not provided; tax provision cannot be calculated exactly without 2025 taxable result
Rounding policy for depreciation is not specified; vehicle and software depreciation produce decimals
Counter-account for reversing prepaid expenses is not specified; likely expense account(s) must be confirmed
Year-end posting date is not explicitly stated; likely use 2025-12-31
Using one accumulated depreciation account 1209 for all assets may be acceptable per prompt but may differ from chart-of-accounts practice

planned_endpoints.summary: Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.

rules: Use params={"number": XXXX} to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
This is a QUERY PARAM via the params field — NOT json_body.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
POSTING BALANCE RULES (which determines single-leg vs manual-leg):
vatType != 0 (e.g. id=3 for 25%): include ONLY the debit posting with GROSS amount. Tripletex auto-generates VAT + credit.
vatType == 0 (exempt): include BOTH debit AND credit postings manually. They must sum to 0.
If you get 422 'postings don't sum to 0': you used vatType=0 but only one posting. Either add the credit posting manually OR change to the correct vatType (e.g. 3 for 25%).
NEVER default to vatType=0 for standard purchases — use vatType=3 (25%) unless explicitly VAT-exempt.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Resolve account numbers: GET /ledger/account with params={"number": XXXX}, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.

payload.trace_example_task: Year-end closing vouchers. 3-6 API calls. Use account numbers from prompt directly.

payload.question: For year-end closing in Tripletex, what is the exact minimal request body for POST /ledger/voucher to create manual no-VAT vouchers dated 2025-12-31 with two postings (debit/credit), including required fields like voucherType if any? Also, for reversing prepaid expenses when only account 1700 is specified and no counteraccount is given, what standard counteraccount should be used according to Tripletex/Norwegian practice? Finally, if taxable income is not provided in the prompt, should I skip the tax provision voucher or use a fallback amount?

payload.headline: All 6 checks failed: wrong account IDs used for depreciation and prepaid expense reversal
what_went_wrong: Used hardcoded account IDs (e.g., 482397416, 482397390, 482397514) without verifying they map to the correct accounts (6010, 1209, 1700) — likely wrong mappings caused all checks to fail.
Made 6 redundant GET /ledger/account calls but apparently failed to correctly extract/use the account IDs for 6010, 1209, and 1700 in the voucher postings.
Kjøretøy depreciation amount 28785.71 is incorrect: 201500/7 = 28785.71 is mathematically correct but the account mapping failure invalidated the entry regardless.
Tax provision voucher was skipped entirely — agent refused to calculate taxable income from the ledger balance, losing those scoring points.
what_worked: Three separate depreciation vouchers were posted as required, and the prepaid expense reversal voucher was also posted.
Depreciation amounts were calculated correctly (13070, 28785.71, 70783.33 NOK).
what_to_try_next: After GET /ledger/account, explicitly log and verify which returned account number maps to 6010, 1209, 1210, 1230, 1250, 1700, 8700, 2920 before using their IDs in voucher postings.
To calculate tax provision, use GET /ledger/openPost or GET /ledger/balance to derive the 2025 taxable income, then post 22% as debit 8700 / credit 2920.
Reduce the 6 GET /ledger/account calls to 1-2 calls with broader queries (e.g., fetch all accounts at once) and map by account number field in the response.
unnecessary_calls: 5 of the 6 GET /ledger/account calls are redundant — one call returning all accounts would suffice for all lookups.
The agent made separate GET /ledger/account calls per account instead of batching, wasting 5 calls.
